title: Account Registration, Activation and Program Tier at the Home Delivery Pharmacy
content:
## Program description: the home delivery account

**Rule.** A Home Delivery Pharmacy account is registered when the member signs up or the first prescription for them arrives, and is activated once a verified shipping address and a payment method (or the member's choice to be billed by statement) are recorded; a registered account dispenses nothing. The account belongs to the member and survives plan changes; its program tier is the one the member's current sponsor elected, and orders are adjudicated under the plan coverage in force on the ship date. A pharmacist is reachable around the clock where the program provides round-the-clock pharmacist access, and a balance statement is sent at the program's statement cycle while a balance is due.

### Account states

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Registered | signed up or set up on the first prescription; dispenses nothing |
| Active | completed with a verified shipping address and a payment method or the choice to be billed; can dispense |
| On hold | placed on hold by the system when an order would take the balance above the credit limit, a card charge is declined after retries, or the shipping address fails verification |
| Closed | closed on the member's confirmation of a closure request |

### Moves between states

| From | To | By |
|---|---|---|
| Registered | Active | the agent, once the address is verified and the payment method or billing choice is recorded |
| Active | On hold | the system |
| On hold | Active | the agent, once the cause of the hold is cleared |
| Registered, Active or On hold | Closed | the member's confirmation |

### Questions answered

- *Does the account change when the member's plan changes?* No. It belongs to the member and survives plan changes; its program tier follows the current sponsor's election.
- *Which plan coverage prices an order?* The coverage in force on the ship date.
- *Can a registered account fill a prescription?* No; a registered account dispenses nothing until it is activated.
